SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-26-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SLOAN IV, JAMES PARK RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MISSION PIERS DEVELOPMENT LLC DBA"THE GANTRY" $185.00 PRINCIPAL, $5.12 INTEREST, $65.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $255.12, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF: $185 FOR CLEANING FEE PLUS PREJUDGMENT INTEREST AND COSTS. THE UTILITY CHARGE THROUGH THE END OF THE LEASE TERM IS APPROPRIATE; TENANT WAS CONTRACTUALLY OBLIGED TO PAY THROUGH THE LEASE TERM. LANDLORD FAILED TO PROVE CLEANING FEE WAS WARRANTED AND DID NOT COMPLY WITH CC1950.5. PREJUDGMENT INTEREST RUNS FROM 7/21/18. I DO NOT FIND BAD FAITH. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, THE JUDGMENT IN THIS ACTION HAS BEEN PAID IN FULL OR OTHERWISE SATISFIED. AS TO DEFENDANT MISSION PIERS DEVELOPMENT LLC DBA"THE GANTRY"
